sharingOwnerRules.label: Sales Opportunities - Read for Finance Team
sharingOwnerRules.description: Finance Team Members review Discount Requests and handle Instalment Plans, both Master-Detail children of Opportunity, so they inherit visibility from it. Head of Finance gets this through the role hierarchy.

sharingOwnerRules.label: Sales Opportunities - Read for Customer Service
sharingOwnerRules.description: Customer Service answers customer questions about their purchase and instalment plan. Instalment Plan is a Master-Detail child of Opportunity, so it can only be shared through the Opportunity. Covers Head of Customer Service and, as subordinates, Customer Service Agents.

sharingOwnerRules.label: Sales Opportunities - Read for Legal Team
sharingOwnerRules.description: Legal handles escalations on defaulted Instalment Plans and needs the plan, its sale and guarantor. Instalment Plan is a Master-Detail child of Opportunity, so it can only be shared through the Opportunity.

sharingOwnerRules.label: Sales Opportunities - Read for Management
sharingOwnerRules.description: Management oversees all sales and their Discount Requests. The Management role sits beside the sales branch under CEO, so it has no hierarchy access to sales records.
